name: Support Factory
summary: One agent that triages support conversations, drafts answers from your docs and code, hands bugs to engineering, clusters feedback and proposes help-center fixes. Replies stay drafts until you allow sending.

secrets.name: SUPPORT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.why: Signs the webhook your product calls for in-app feedback (Authorization: Bearer).

secrets.name: PLAIN_API_KEY
secrets.why: Desk Plain, when the workspace has no Plain connector.

secrets.name: INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.why: Desk Intercom, when the workspace has no Intercom connector.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_API_TOKEN
secrets.why: Desk Zendesk, with ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN and ZENDESK_EMAIL, when the workspace has no Zendesk connector.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN
secrets.why: Desk Zendesk: the <subdomain> of https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com. Not a secret.

secrets.name: ZENDESK_EMAIL
secrets.why: Desk Zendesk: the email of the dedicated agent seat the API token belongs to.

secrets.name: GH_TOKEN
secrets.why: File bug tickets as GitHub issues, open help-center pull requests, and read or write a json-file desk in a private repository.
